item.title: 10 Hidden Signs You're in a Relationship With a Narcissist (And How to Protect Yourself)
item.description: You are likely in a relationship with a narcissist if your partner consistently exhibits a grandiose sense of self-importance, requires endless admiration, and completely lacks genuine empathy for your feelings and boundaries.
